text_blocks.snippet: People with schizophrenia face a significantly higher risk of developing cardiovascular disease and experiencing premature death due to heart-related issues compared to the general population. This increased risk is influenced by a combination of factors, including lifestyle choices, side effects of antipsychotic medications, and underlying biological factors.
